mapper.sql: b.id, b.title, b.author, b.isbn, b.publisher, b.publish_year, b.total_copies, b.available_copies, b.category_id, c.name as category_name, b.shelf_location, b.summary, b.cover_url, b.created_at, b.updated_at
mapper.select: select from books b left join categories c on c.id = b.category_id where b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into books (title, author, isbn, publisher, publish_year, total_copies, available_copies, category_id, shelf_location, summary, cover_url) values (#{title}, #{author}, #{isbn}, #{publisher}, #{publishYear}, #{totalCopies}, #{availableCopies}, #{categoryId}, #{shelfLocation}, #{summary}, #{coverUrl})
mapper.update: update books set title = #{title}, author = #{author}, isbn = #{isbn}, publisher = #{publisher}, publish_year = #{publishYear}, total_copies = #{totalCopies}, available_copies = #{availableCopies}, category_id = #{categoryId}, shelf_location = #{shelfLocation}, summary = #{summary}, cover_url = #{coverUrl} where id = #{id}
update books set available_copies = available_copies - 1 where id = #{id} and available_copies > 0
update books set available_copies = available_copies + 1 where id = #{id} and available_copies < total_copies
